name: Overview and Cross-domain Projections
purpose: Define Overview/main-view composition as rebuildable read projections over accepted owning-domain truth, with explicit scope, freshness, coverage, unknown/partial state and navigation back to authoritative workspaces.

decisions.decision: Overview owns no independent operational truth; every card/count/trend/timeline/warning is a derived projection over accepted owning-domain identities, relationships, events, snapshots and coverage.
Customer and period scope are explicit query inputs applied consistently to cards, rows, trends, warnings, narrative and exports where applicable.
Unknown, partial, stale, excluded and unresolved states remain explicit and are never coerced into zero, complete, healthy or failed values.
Drafts, unsaved working copies and rejected/deferred proposals never affect authoritative Overview values.
Communication metrics derive from canonical HLD-10 links/coverage; MSG drafts are excluded from sent evidence and terminal summaries remain minimized.
Objective context derives through Tasks; Overview does not create direct mutable SR-to-Objective relationships.
Inventory metrics consume HLD-08 projections and expose constituent partial/action-required positions rather than false aggregate completion.
SLA cards/cohort health consume HLD-07 live calculations or immutable report snapshots and must disclose as-of/scope/denominator/policy context appropriate to the presentation.
Operational narrative is a deterministic human-readable projection of accepted current/near-term facts, not a separately editable journal or AI-generated source of truth.
Overview projections may be cached/materialized only as disposable rebuildable read models; authoritative writes always occur through the owning domain.

unresolved_here_by_design: exact query/materialized-view strategy and cache invalidation
exact period presets and trend comparison windows
